bio.short: TWON is a San Francisco DJ who excels at both house and hip hop. He can carry a night on house, tech house, and afro house, or run a full hip hop and R&B set, and when a room wants both he crosses over so smoothly the floor never feels the switch. Vibes curator, festival lover, and a DJ you can book for either night.
long: TWON is a San Francisco DJ with two home bases: house and hip hop. He plays both at full strength, never one as a side dish to the other.

On house nights he moves through house, tech house, and afro house, building from rolling grooves to a peak. On hip hop nights he runs West Coast bounce, R&B, throwbacks, and today's hits. When a room wants both, he crosses over without dropping the groove. A festival lover at heart, TWON reads the floor first and plays for the vibe, not the playlist.

That range shows up in his own work, from house flips like House Every Weekend (TWON x BRWDY Edit) to DEEP CUTZ, his series digging into hip hop catalogs, starting with YG. TODO: add where you play, residencies, or what's next.
